description: PyPSA-KZ-Data is a public set of model inputs and configuration for a Kazakhstan electricity transition study. Its repository documents monthly demand from the national market operator, power-plant information, scenario configuration and a workflow built on PyPSA-Earth. Users can prepare a country-specific model and run the linked workflow; outputs are model-ready tables and scenario configurations for Kazakhstan. Geographic coverage is Kazakhstan, with some Asian weather cutouts required by the broader workflow. The README states AGPL-3.0-or-later for the repository. A limitation is that some upstream HydroBASINS inputs may require separate access in Kazakhstan, according to the README; this review did not fetch any dependent data or test the run. Study assumptions also reflect the cited 2024 work, not current policy. The repository can help compare generation and network futures. The related catalogue ENTSO-E transparency platform covers Europe and is not this Kazakhstan case. No dataset or model archive was downloaded.
name: PyPSA-KZ Kazakhstan electricity case inputs
notes: G7 G7-1669. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
